files.description: Daily weather at one station (90 rows, one per day in date order from 2025-06-01, no gaps): date (YYYY-MM-DD), temp_c (mean temperature in degrees C, two decimals; about 1% empty), humidity (percent, whole number).

task_text: The standard error of the mean of a window is the sample standard deviation of its values (dividing by n - 1) divided by the square root of n, the number of values in the window. For each day, use a centred 5-day window (the day, the 2 days before and the 2 days after) and give the standard error of the mean temperature; leave it empty when the window does not have 5 temperatures. `result` should be a Series indexed by date.
intended_computation: For each day with 2 days on either side and 5 present values in rows i-2..i+2: sample sd / sqrt(5); missing otherwise (first 2 and last 2 days, windows with the empty temperature).

predicted_direction.reason: The centred rolling().sem() used sqrt(n - 1) on 2.x; 3.x uses sqrt(n), the task's definition.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row X01; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
